title: Implement XML prompt templates and config.json in-memory caching
task_summary: Stop re-reading template XML files and the configuration JSON file from disk on every single session dispatch, eliminating blocking file I/O operations from the async codebase.

files_changed.change: Implemented _TEMPLATE_CACHE and clear_template_cache() in _load_template() to cache rules.xml, gates.xml, anti_patterns.xml, environment.xml, and context.xml XML text.
Implemented _CONFIG_CACHE and clear_config_cache() in load_config() to cache parsed config.json dictionary in-memory.
Added test_prompt_builder_and_config_loader_caching unit test to assert identical byte output and count/verify avoided disk reads using low-level I/O mocks and custom dummy config file.

assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed via mock Path.read_text and builtins.open that subsequent build_session_prompt calls hit in-memory caches and register 0 additional disk reads, while cache clearers correctly force re-reads.
Asserted that calling build_session_prompt with identical input maps produces byte-for-byte identical output before and after cache population.

decisions.decision: Cache loaded config dict keyed by Path in config_loader.py
decisions.reasoning: Resolving Path objects to absolute paths prevents redundant file reads if callers use different relative paths to access the same configuration file, while maintaining simplicity.

self_review.checked: Prompt builder cache keys, config loader path resolutions, mock assertion triggers, and cache clear paths.
changes_made: Wrote and cleaned up a physical config.json file in dryrun/test_gaps.py so that path.exists() correctly returns True under different environment conditions during tests, allowing load_config to run open() without throwing custom not-found blocks.

notes_for_next_step: Step 16 is fully completed. All blocking template and config file I/O operations are optimized and cached.
